why: The host's mapper rewrites the name and the address of the link only: the forms legitimately name different servers.

singbox.why: the mapper renamed the server in the link only: the JSON forms have it under its own name

xray.why: the mapper renamed the server in the link only: the JSON forms have it under its own name

links.why: the JSON forms name the server as the host does; the link has another name

singbox.why: No link names it: against the Xray JSON, Remnawave's sing-box generator (singbox.generator.service.ts) writes neither the host's finalmask nor its sockopt (tcpFastOpen).

xray.why: the JSON forms name the server as the host does; the link has another name
notes: fm (finalmask): the delays of the fragment mask are not applied, a pause of this host is not a link's to set
